Funding oneOf object scopes omit required discriminator keys/additionalProperties; meaningful method/network/group and status variants use the native documented discriminator.
Legacy native string/integer/number unions overlap; Fin accepts equivalent exact text through normalized anyOf without inventing numeric precision.

Source response examples are referenced by raw JSON Pointer and parsed by Rust arbitrary-precision JSON, so Python never rewrites their decimal lexemes.
Synthetic business-failure tests inject mapped transport errors; this suite does not independently prove live/HTTP CCXT rejection classification.
Nonce is owned by the protected transport; API-level 2FA otp is excluded; legacy new:true is a separate protected generation operation.
